bundled.built_from: Unmodified final build layer from the official benweet/stackedit:v5.15.4 container image (benweet/stackedit@sha256:b1505e5a1a56f8cbe395dd1989aa50dfa3773726c8ae763b69983d523734b0ce). The opt/stackedit/dist/ tree contains the production assets and source maps; the npm source archive alone does not contain this production build.

modifications: none; the static server serves the original production bytes from the official image layer.
configuration: Serve /app, / and /index.html on HOST:PORT. Browser workspace data is stored in IndexedDB. The static allowlist excludes source maps, service workers and alternative entry pages. CSP and the runtime restrict custom template execution while preserving built-in templates and the embedding message interface.

notes.source_availability: The npm archive contains StackEdit source; the official image build layer includes source maps with bundled module sourcesContent. Both archives are distributed unmodified.
